samir: Follow-up thread for PM-2026-11. Summary: we need clear owners, JIRA links, and a RACI for each remediation. Posting suggested owners + timelines below. Please ack or propose swaps within 48h.

Actions:
A) circuit-breaker tuning + unit tests (JIRA-6120) - owner: samir - 5 business days
B) rollout healthcheck + canary gate (JIRA-6121) - owner: toni + eng-deploy - 7 business days
C) recurring cache eviction deep-dive (JIRA-6122) - owner: rachael - 4 business days
D) runbook update & tabletop (JIRA-6123) - owner: claire - 3 business days
E) add recurrence flag to postmortem template (internal) - owner: claire - 2 business days

claire: Ack on 6123 and E. I'll draft the runbook PR and schedule a 1hr tabletop with oncall. Will include acceptance criteria and test steps.

toni: I'll own 6121 but need eng-deploy as Consulted. Proposed RACI: Toni (R), eng-deploy (C), Samir (A), Claire (I). I'll open subtask for the canary metrics harness.

infra-bot: Created subtask JIRA-6121.1 for canary harness: https://jira.redwood.local/browse/JIRA-6121.1

samir: For 6120 I'll push a small mitigation first (increase threshold + add jitter) then follow with thorough tests. Will assign PR to @toni for integration tests.

rachael: Taking 6122. Noted 4 previous eviction events in last 30d at ~01:40 UTC. I'll attach heap profiles and KV metrics to the ticket and try to reproduce in staging. Expect initial findings in 3 business days.

claire: On the recurrence flag: propose auto-tagging postmortems with >2 occurrences and a weekly "recurrence-review" meeting. I'll add automation to the board and a checklist item in the template.

toni: Agree. Also recommend we require a "remediation-verification" comment before PM closure with deployment SHA, smoke run ids, and perf traces. This should be enforced by the postmortem owner.

samir: Good call. I'll add that note to JIRA-6120 and include a short verification playbook in the PR.

rachael: One ask: if a remediation spans multiple teams, create subtask per team and RACI each subtask. That helps us avoid cross-team ownership confusion.

claire: Will do that for 6123 if needed. PR for runbook template coming shortly: https://github.com/redwood/ops-runbooks/pull/956

infra-bot: Reminder: scheduled recurrence-review slot created on the postmortem board every Wed 09:00 UTC.

samir: Final: If you accept an owner assignment here please update the corresponding JIRA with RACI and estimated due date. I'll close owner-assignments in 48h unless someone asks to swap. Thanks. :thumbsup:
